stemMd: The same room is printed once at 1:50 and once at 1:100. What is the ratio of its printed areas, first drawing to second drawing?
explanationMd: The1:50 drawing has twice every linear dimension of the1:100 drawing. Area scales as the square of the length factor, so the area ratio is2²:1 =4:1.

distractorRationale.a: This is the ratio of lengths, not areas.
distractorRationale.c: This reverses the length ratio and ignores squaring.
distractorRationale.e: The first drawing is larger, not smaller.
distractorRationale.d: The two scales produce different printed sizes.
